CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   C. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   D. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the volume
   D. Only the costume

3. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

   A. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.

5. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   C. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.

6. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.

   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.

7. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Black, white, and grey

8. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Netball.
   C. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   D. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   B. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.

10. Best practice when working on Middle Distance Races and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Middle Distance Races and Montage.
   B. Damage equipment used for Middle Distance Races and Montage.
   C. Practise Middle Distance Races and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Middle Distance Races and Montage.

11. Best practice when working on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

13. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   B. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.

14. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

15. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Components of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Drawing and Painting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Craft and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
